ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark-gray) pixels covering approximately 95% of the surface, with localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters representing roughly 5% of the visible area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity dark field across both lobes. Distinct high-intensity white circular rings and irregular mottling are localized on the distal tips and sparse focal points on the interior lobe surfaces. Two prominent high-contrast white rings are located on the mid-left lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate interior angle of 65 degrees, extending into a high-depth bounding box relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire margin. High-amplitude saw-tooth peaks are clustered on the distal thirds of both lobes. Significant jagged irregularity and deeper indentations are visible on the inner-left trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal trajectory exhibiting moderate concavity adjacent to the median notch and transitioning to a sharp upward convexity towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct vertical white linear marks located on the medial-left lobe surface, breaking the primary dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronunced notch or 'bite' indentation on the inner-left trailing edge near the median notch. Multiple circular white depigmented scars distributed across both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-definition circular 'O-ring' scar on the central-left lobe area.
